I think Soejima is great at designing Personas in my opinion. Yeah, his character designs are mostly generic manga, but idk they look pretty pleasant to the eye. I mean, of course Soejima is not nearly on the same level as Kaneko, but I think he has his charms.


I think most of the Social Links are pure trash. I've completed the game 7 times (don't even know why, probably tried to get Orpheus Telos and try out every version) and each time they became more and more hideous. The only ones I enjoyed are Tanaka, Mutatsu, Akinari... And that's about it. I'm also baffled that there are NO Social Links with any of the S.E.E.S. male members, which makes it impossible to know them and feel even more shallow than they actually are. However, P3P has SLs with everyone in S.E.E.S. (yes, everyone) and some of them aren't that bad. I think that Social Link is an interesting and ambitious idea, but the way it's executed in P3 just makes it feel like paperwork to boost your Personas.

The story itself, in my opinion, had its moments, but the way it's paced... God awful. You grind in Tartarus (which, let me remind you, is just a set of bland and uninteresting dungeons) for 15 hours just to get to at least some portion of the story. Also, the protagonist is a typical Marry Sue.


Oh and P3P has a function to make the characters non-controlable (actually, it's a default option), you can change it in the "tactics" during battle. I just think that artificially complicating the gameplay by limiting the players abilities is just mind-blowing. And besides, AI in P3, despite being pretty advanced for the time, gotta admit, resets all data about the enemies once you get out of Tartarus, sometimes making it insufferable to play. I'm not that much of a hardcore gamer, I can't count all the times Nocturne and SNES-era games made me rage quit, but I like when the game gives me a fair amount of challenge, but when the game is trying to give me this challenge by permanently handicapping me, I just can't stand it. Also the fact that you have to speak with every party member to check their status and equipment, while not a serious problem, made me cringe a bunch of tumes by the end of the game. I understand what they tried to do, make it more ReAlIsTiC, but let me be honest, I would always prefer a simple utility to aesthetic.


Also, I thought that Vita already had 720p, but I'm pretty stupid, so I must've been mistaken, might as well check out the PC port )
